[Thinking]
**Identifying the fastest animal**

The user is asking about the fastest animal, likely overall speed. The peregrine falcon holds the title in a dive, reaching speeds of 200+ mph (over 320 km/h), with some records up to 240 mph (386 km/h). For level flight, the common swift is around 69 mph (111 km/h). The fastest land animal is the cheetah, at 60-70 mph (97-113 km/h), while the sailfish and black marlin compete for fastest marine animal, typically around 68 mph (110 km/h).
[/Thinking]

The peregrine falcon. In a hunting dive (stoop) it can exceed 200 mph (320 km/h), making it the fastest animal.
